meta.description: Short engineering notes from building Stelstone — releases, decisions, lessons.

properties.content: Short engineering notes from building Stelstone: releases, decisions, and the occasional lesson learned the hard way. Newest first.

August 17, 2026

This site is now served by Stelstone itself: one Cloudflare Worker runs the landing you came from, the admin panel, and the API. This very page is a JSON record in the site's repository, written through /admin, published as a git commit — the loop we ask you to trust is the loop we run on.

items: The stelstone package family on npm — install with `npm install stelstone`
A one-click starter: the Deploy to Cloudflare button on stelstone-starter
Draft branches on the GitHub backend, so saving never publishes
Per-page publishing, build-time link verification, automatic 301s
A forms endpoint, so a contact form needs no third-party service

properties.content: Everything is MIT and on GitHub. If you hand websites to clients and like your phone quiet, try it on your next handoff.
